metadata.description: Free Claude Code mods by Joseph Bennett: cost and cache control, task tracking, helpers, guards, reports and creative studios.

plugins.name: session-keeper
plugins.description: Session Keeper: A cache bar above the prompt with rewrite and session cost, a smart next-command button, a hold on cold-cache messages, and a device-aware handoff

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: Mission Control: A red goal bar that tracks the real task list, /goal, and an All Tasks view across every open chat

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: Helper Desk: A Helper Desk tab with a fox card per helper agent, chat cost, helper tokens and time, a saved to-do list, and a team-size dock

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Collision Guard: Stops two open chats editing the same file: proceed, move to a worktree, or cancel

plugins.name: prompt-forge
plugins.description: Prompt Forge: Turns a long brain dump into a clear brief in Anthropic's recommended shape, asks the questions that matter first, and queues next prompts with /after

plugins.name: rule-keeper
plugins.description: Rule Keeper: Spots lasting rules you give Claude and saves the ones you approve to your Obsidian vault, plus pins above the prompt

plugins.name: session-ledger
plugins.description: Session Ledger: In this chat (to-dos, connectors, skills, files, repos, vault folders) and a Today / Week / Month / Year report at your hourly rate

plugins.name: mod-switchboard
plugins.description: Mod Switchboard: One Mods tab with an on/off switch for every mod and every part of a mod

plugins.name: higgs-content
plugins.description: Higgs Content: A photo and video studio on the Higgsfield connector: describe, review the upgraded prompt and credit cost, create, and browse the gallery

plugins.name: auto-model
plugins.description: Auto Model: Picks the model, effort, Fast mode and ultracode for every prompt, and compacts first when a switch would re-read a long chat

plugins.name: file-tree
plugins.description: File Tree: A Files tab showing what Claude is reading or editing right now, every file it touched, and the folder tree with changes highlighted

plugins.name: design-picker
plugins.description: Design Picker: Opens by itself on design questions: live mockup cards built with design skills, with motion, and a Send to Figma step

plugins.name: idea-shelf
plugins.description: Idea Shelf: Park side ideas per project in your Obsidian vault without breaking Claude's focus, then send or drop each one

plugins.name: edit-rewind
plugins.description: Edit Rewind: Step through a turn's edits, undo a turn, and restore from a snapshot timeline

plugins.name: privacy-shield
plugins.description: Privacy Shield: Masks names, emails, phones and amounts while you share your screen, keeps keys out of what Claude reads, and blocks .env and SSH key files

plugins.name: assumption-radar
plugins.description: Assumption Radar: Lists decisions Claude made without asking so you can mark each right or wrong

plugins.name: command-guard
plugins.description: Command Guard: Holds risky shell commands (delete everything, force push, hard reset) until you press Proceed

plugins.name: limit-guard
plugins.description: Limit Guard: Stops runaway helpers, huge prompts and retry loops before they burn your plan limits

plugins.name: voice-guard
plugins.description: Voice Guard: Flags AI-sounding phrases in posts and emails Claude writes, before they go out

plugins.name: site-check
plugins.description: Site Check: /sitecheck scores a website's speed, SEO and accessibility with Lighthouse and explains the fixes
